supportersPage.metaDescription: Supporter recognises people who have made at least {count, number} accepted contributions to Libraries Global. It is earned, never bought.
supportersPage.title: The people who *build the index.*
supportersPage.lead: Supporter is the recognition for {count, number} accepted contributions: new libraries, corrections, photos, translations and more. It can’t be bought, and it adds no extra tools or authority.
supportersPage.acceptedCount: {count, plural, one {# accepted contribution} other {# accepted contributions}} so far.
supportersPage.notListed: Your name is not listed publicly.
supportersPage.markShown: Your profile shows the Supporter mark.
supportersPage.markBody: Shown beside your name on your profile. Hide it at any time in Settings.
supportersPage.creditBody: Your display name and, if your profile shows it, your location. Listing is your choice.
supportersPage.onPurpose: That’s all, on purpose. Supporter adds no tools, limits or authority. It doesn’t change what you can edit or how reviews work, and it can’t be bought.
supportersPage.previewTitle: How the mark looks on a profile
supportersPage.previewNote: The mark shows earned recognition, nothing else. It leaves your profile the moment you hide it.
supportersPage.stepsLead: Every accepted contribution counts once. Reviewers check each one.

first.title: Your first accepted contribution
first.body: Makes you a Contributor and unlocks {count, plural, =2 {two Reach calculations} one {# Reach calculation} other {# Reach calculations}} a week.

count.title: Each accepted change counts
count.body: A new library, a correction, a photo, a translation, a Journal story and more. Streaks, bonuses and points adjustments don’t count.

milestone.title: {count, number} accepted contributions
milestone.body: You become a Supporter, with an optional profile mark and credit on this page.

listing.q: Do I have to be listed?
listing.a: No. Switch off listing here or in your profile settings. Private and limited profiles are never listed. If you make your profile public again, choose whether to turn listing back on.

shown.q: What shows next to my name?
shown.a: Your display name links to your public profile. Your city and country appear only if you show your location publicly. Your email and account details are never shown.

mark.q: Can I hide the Supporter mark?
mark.a: Yes. The mark has its own switch in profile settings. Hiding it doesn’t change whether you’re listed on this page.

who.a: Anyone with at least {count, number} accepted contributions who chooses to be listed. Daily streaks, bonuses and points adjustments don’t count towards the total.

buy.a: No. It can only be earned through accepted contributions. Payment, including API Access or sponsorship, never buys recognition, trust, ranking or editorial treatment.

revoked.a: Yes, if a moderator finds that contributions were fraudulent or duplicated. Your listing and mark then disappear, and your visibility choices are kept.

organisations.a: Yes, through sponsorship. Sponsors are acknowledged publicly and never gain influence over records, ranking or moderation. Staff and volunteers can still earn Supporter through their own contributions.

supportersPage.sponsorBody: Organisations can sponsor Libraries Global to help cover servers, maps and data for everyone. Sponsors are acknowledged publicly and get no influence over records, ranking or moderation.
supportersPage.closingBody: Add a missing library, correct a record or share a photo. Every accepted contribution counts towards Supporter, and your first unlocks {count, plural, =2 {two Reach calculations} one {# Reach calculation} other {# Reach calculations}} a week.
